panel.dialog.card.title: What this card measures
panel.dialog.hooks.body_html:
The hooks suggest; you decide whether to delegate. This does not measure how many suggestions were followed —nothing links a suggestion to the delegation that came after—, but where the read hook warned and why it stayed quiet the rest of the time.

Category is the hook that suggested (read, shell) or the task the prompt hook recognised in your message (summary, extraction, classification, translation, boilerplate). Reads seen splits the reads the read hook saw by what it did with them: it warned, or stayed quiet because the read was bounded, code, small, went through another MCP or the backend was missing.
panel.dialog.system.body_html:
The RAM, the GPU load and the VRAM of the machine running this dashboard, and the backend processes found on it. The process list is only read on Windows and Linux; on macOS neither RAM nor VRAM is measured yet, and the row shows «—».

With the backend on another machine, the Backend row links to that machine's dashboard, which is where its RAM, VRAM and processes are shown. That dashboard asks for that machine's token, not this one's.

panel.help.body_html:
Context kept = the input content the MCP read server-side (calls with path) that never entered Claude's context window. These are tokens that did not take up your context, not a measured slice of quota: Anthropic does not publish the quota in tokens, and the quota has its own block. inline calls already travelled through your context, so they do not count as savings. It is counted once per delegation even when the MCP chunks it: what stayed out of your context is the document, not the GPU's work.

Local cost = the input tokens the backend actually consumed, summing all calls. A chunked delegation repeats the system prompt in every chunk, so chunking does cost here. Set against the savings, it tells an efficient delegation from one that burnt the GPU several times.

Generated locally = output tokens: generation work done by the local models instead of Claude.

local cost: the real token the backend reports, characters ÷ 4 only when it is missing  ·  context kept: Claude tokens by family and content type  ·  real savings = only calls with source=path
